title: 1757 raid on Berlin
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1757 raid on Berlin", at revision 1376165731, opens: "The 1757 raid on Berlin took place during the Third Silesian War. Cavalrymen of the Holy Roman Empire attacked and briefly occupied Berlin, the capital of Prussia. According to an apocryphal story General Hadik picked up gloves in Berlin for Empress Maria Theresa, but after leaving he realized that he got only gloves for her left hand. He returned to Berlin and got also the gloves for her right hand." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q322882, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1757 skirmish". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
